tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bla ma'i rnal 'byor gug shi jo 'bum ma bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ spyir 'o skor rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams gsang sngags pa rten 'brel lam du byed pa yin/ rten 'brel gyi gzhi bla ma la sangs rgyas su mthong ba cig dgos par gda'/ de la 'o skol gyi rje rin po che rdo rje 'chang dngos yin par 'dug ste kho bos kyang sku gshegs kha dang*/ de'i rting gi rnam thar min pa ma go da gzod bdag la rkang gi khong nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes/ de nyid kyang rje chen po sman gyi bla 'od kyi rgyal por bsgoms la de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin du bsgom/ yang na spyan ras gzigs sam rje btsun ma sgrol ma gang mos su bsgom/ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin du bsgoms la lus rdo rje skyil krung ngam/ skyil krung ci bder bsdad/ de ma nus na yang sngas shin tu mtho bar byas la glo phab nas sems kyis bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin de la phyi rol gyi longs spyod rnams dbul/ de nas dgra dang gdon rnams dbul/ de nas gnyen rnams dbul/ gos tshun chad kyang phul la rang gcer bu ma yin pa thams cad dbul/ de nas bla ma'i mdun du rang gi sems kyis mtshon cig blangs la rang gi thod pa bcad la thod pa'i sgyed po gsum gyi steng du thod pa'i snod gling bzhi bas rgya che ba cig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas rkang pa g.yas nas mgo bzung la rim gyis bcad cing thod pa chen po de'i nang du bskur la/ nang gi rting la gcod mkhan gyi lag pa g.yas pa'ang de'i nang du bskyur/ de nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi lha'i bdud rtsi dang*/ mi'i longs spyod thams cad kyang blos blangs lade'i nang du gzhug de nas thod pa'i 'og nas me chen po 'bar bas/ bdag gi lus kyi dum bu dang*/ lha'i bdud rtsi la sogs pa thams cad khol nas 'dres pa'i rlangs pa 'od zer gyi tshul du phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang*/

byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thams cad kyang*/ der babs nas gcig tu 'dres/ yang skabs 'dir rang gi lus po yod pa snyam byed pa cig yod pas lus thams cad dum bu dum bur byas la thod pa chen po der bskyur la/ rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs la mgon ma mchis pa bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod nas gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus nas bla ma la bskor ba'i tshul gyis sa steng dang sa 'og dang bar snang thams cad sprin bzhin btibs nas spyir sems can thams cad dang*/ sgos su gang sdug cing nyam thag pa rnams la ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes dbugs phyung bar bsam/ de nas rang gi lus bdud rtsir song ba de bla mas gtso byas pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ji ltar bzhed pa'i longs spyod du gyur nas mnyes shing dgyes par bsam/ lhag ma rnams sems can dmyal ba'i bar gyi rigs drug rnams la byin pas tshim zhing dgyes te/ gcig la gcig pha ma'i 'du shes skyes te/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems skyes te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar zhugs par bsam mo// de nas dngos grub blang ste bla mas gtso byas pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po byung*/ bdag gi dpral bar zhugs/ sku'i dngos grub stsal/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ bdag gi mgrin par zhugs/ gsung gi dngos grub stsal/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po byung*/ bdag gi snying gar zhugs/ thugs kyi dngos grub stsal/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bla ma dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'ja' tshon gyi tshul du byung*/

bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mtha' dag gi dngos grub stsal/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam/ de nas de kho na nyid la blo gzhag par bya ste/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams kyang rmi lam lta bu/ bdag gi lus gtubs pa'ang rmi lam/ slar bag chags kyi lus su snang ba'ang rmi lam/ de la 'od zer gyis dbang bskur te/ dngos grub blangs pa'ang rmi lam/ bdag mi yin par snang ba'ang rmi lam/ na bar 'dug pa'ang rmi lam/ nad drag par snang ba'ang rmi lam/ des na rmi lam gyi skye rga na 'chi la su 'jigs/ ma go ba rnams gnyid kyi rmi lam na nad drag pos btab pa la shin tu sdug bsngal bar yod pa las sad pa de'i tshe/ rmi lam du 'dug pas de la sdug bsngal ba rang 'khrul bar 'dug rmi lam du na yang su phung*/ drag kyang su 'tsheng*/ des na rmi lam 'dis bdag mtshan thog thag tu mgo bskor snyam pa de bzhin du gnyid sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi skye rga na 'chi yang rmi lam dang 'dra bas su yang 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro// de la gzu lums tsam ma yin pa/ rig pas dpyad nas nges shes skye dgos te/ 'di ltar rmi lam mthong ba yul med pa// ma sad bar la rtogs ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar rmi lam du na yang gnyid ma sad kyi bar la rmi lam yin snyam du ngo mi shes/ gnyid nam sad pa na 'o na da ci'i sdug bsngal de rnams rmi lam du 'dug snyam du phyis nges shes skye/ de bzhin du da lta'ang ma rig pa'i gnyid log pa'i rmi lam yin pas/ rmi lam yin byas kyang*/ ci srid 'khor ba pa ma rig pa'i gnyid ma sad kyi bar la rmi lam du mi go ste/ dper na da lta gnyid log pa'i rmi lam na rmi lam yin par mi go ba dang 'dra/ phyis ma rig pa'i gnyid sad nas mthong lam skyed pa na/ gzod go ste 'o na sngar gyi de rnams 'khrul par 'dug pas tshe ring thung dang na mi na la sogs pa gang la'ang 'jigs rgyu mi 'dug pa la don med par ngas ji tsam zhig sdug bsngal byas snyam pa legs par go nas sdug bsngal thams cad las grol lo// des na da lta'ang sdug bsngal ngo shes par bya/

sems la ni skye 'jig med/ skye shir snang ba rmi lam yun ring thung yin snyam du nges shes bskyed la de kho na nyid la gzhag de'ang rmi lam ji bzhin sgyu ma bzhin// dri za'i grong khyer ji bzhin du// de bzhin skye dang de bzhin gnas// de bzhin du ni 'gag par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de la 'di snyam du 'o na rmi lam gyi snang ba yun thung*/ sad pa'i snang ba yun ring snyam na/ de'ang nges pa med de rmi lam du lo brgyar bsdad pa rmi ba'ang yod/ mir skyes nas zhag gcig ma lon par shi ba'ang yod pa yin yang tshe ring thung du snang ba'ang rang gi rnam rtog gi skye lugs cig las don dam par lta zhog kun rdzob tu 'ang nges pa med de dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud las/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam dang*// zla phyed zla ba lo yi dus// bskal pa grangs med gsum po ni// skad cig gcig tu mnyam par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ bcom ldan 'das bya rgod phung po la bzhugs pa na/ 'og gi phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa zhig sangs rgyas kyi zhabs drung du lhags nas/ bar gyi bskal pa bcu drug tu bcom ldan 'das la bltas/ bcu drug tu chos nyan/ bcu drug tu dris/ bcu drug tu bsams nas rang gi gnas su song ngo*// de'i bar la 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyi phye ma red kyi thun gcig tu mthong bar bshad/ des na rang rang gi snang ba la gnyis ka bden la don dam par gnyis ka ma grub pa yin/ des na tshe ring ngo snyam pa'i rtog pa skyes na ring por 'gro/ thung ngo snyam pa'i rtog pa bzung na thung bar 'gro ba la don dam par tshe ring thung ma grub ste/ dus kyi gzhi skad cig ma don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir ro// dper na rdo gcig med pa la rdo'i phung po mi 'byung ba bzhin no// de lta bu'i tshul gyis nges shes bskyed la/

skye ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ rga ba dang*/ 'chi ba don dam par ma grub pa'i tshul gyis de kho na nyid la blo gzhag spyir na ba dang*/ rga shis 'jigs na lta ba ma go 'khor ba'i rnam rtog gis bsgribs na bskyed rim ma go lta ba mngon par zhen na rdzogs rim ma go ba'i rtags yin/ 'di la nges shes skyes na nad gang yang mi sos mi srid par gda'/ rjes/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa bsngo ba bya'o// //'di bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bye brag gcig lags/ 'di la dmigs pa'i rim pa gsum yod pa'i dang po zhen pa spang ba de rmi ltas bzang ba cig byung byung ngam nges shes skyes skyes bsgom/ 'di kas nad drag po yong ba kun sos kyin gda'/ de nas dmigs pa gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba bsgom/ de nas kho na nyid la blo gzhag la bsgom/ thams cad dus gcig la blos 'chun pa dka' bar gda' bas ji ltar blo la gsal ba bzhin bsgom/ 'dis sman pas bor ba'i nad pa kun kyang sos kyin gda'/ mdze dang dmu chu yang zla ba re 'am lo re tsam gyis sos kyin gda'/ 'di nyams su myong ba lags/ gnas skabs thams cad du mchil ma stong mid bya zhing sgregs pa yang dang yang du gdon/ sems chos nyid la gzhag shes pa ma bcos par yul la blta zhing shes pa bde bar byas la ri mtho sa'am/ nags gseb dang ri brag kun tu dus rgyun du thag ring por 'gro zhing yang de nyid kyi nyin par rang gi gnas su ldog 'di mang du bya/ grub tshad kyis skabs su dge 'dun nam/ bla ma'i phyogs sam/ sems can gyi don du dmigs la sa rdo skyel ba'i las sam/ khur ha cang yang lci ba ma yin pa 'khur/ 'di bogs 'byin du 'gro ba lags pas gal che/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas gug shi jo 'bum gyi don du sbyor ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
